While I understand the concepts, I never developed a deep love for it. It feels more like a necessary tool than a subject I enjoy exploring.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, absolutely. My low openness and moderate neuroticism make complex math intimidating. The rigid logic clashes with my creative side. I prefer the open-ended nature of physics or literature where there is more room for interpretation and less fear of getting a wrong answer.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not really. I am retired and my learning has been self-directed through books and hobbies like baking and knitting. While I know AI exists, I haven't integrated it into my studies. My approach is traditional, relying on established methods rather than new digital tools.
